steps.name: Step 1 — Open a pipeline (create form) and fill Name + Description
Step 2 — Confirm the "Chat starters" section is visible/expanded
Step 3 — Click "+ Starter" and enter text: 'Analyze this data'
Step 4 — Click Save; verify create succeeds (2xx) with no console errors/warnings
Step 5 — Reload the detail page for a pristine 'before any input' state
Step 6 — Verify the saved starter row shows its exact text and a 'delete starter' button
Step 7 — In the chat panel, verify the starter renders as a clickable chip, exactly once
